main_point: This proposes complete extracted-text counts for three source manuscripts, the common paper, all three complete applications and the full program appendix. No compression factor is calculated.
written_papers: The combined comparison will use all three source manuscripts over the whole U_D plus all three applications. Whole U_D is charged here even if another topic reuses a theorem.
including_program: Report separately with the full 12-page appendix included once. It contains all five required programs and all three complete diagnostics. All eight raw files define an alternative sensitivity, never an additional charge to the printed appendix.
conditional: Each source/application comparison is conditional on first acquiring the whole U_D and whole declared complete programme boundary, including all five required programs. The numerator uses the whole source manuscript; main-contract qualifications remain explicit.
drivers: Both complete execution drivers are inventoried and counted separately. They are not in the printed appendix; one retains an unused historical M22 branch. No branch is removed for these raw counts.
scope: All 37 accepted source rows and exclusions are bound. In particular, J2 diagram/Aut/Cor/doubling statements are not all recovered; their original extracted text is still counted.
uncertainty: External classical proofs, subgroup catalogue and algorithm construction, graphics and formula positioning have unknown cost, not zero. This is an extracted-text coordinate, not a full visible-text or research-effort measure.
ruler: Whole PDFs, exact running furniture only; raw untrimmed, raw selected, calibrated selected; NFC and NFKC; five units. Printed hyphens, accent spacing, formula pieces and literal source mistakes are retained.
formal_validation: Separately scoped and priced; the initial accepted D packet has ten declarations, not formal proofs of every application assertion.
required_environment: Python with pypdf version 6.13.0; the three bound primary PDFs supplied locally.
